biggest_catch: Furniture marketplaces are slow and expensive: AptDeco takes roughly a fifth to over a third of your sale in fees, and you wait on a buyer, a delivery slot, and their acceptance before a dollar moves.
catches: Fees of roughly 19%-38% take a large cut of the sale price.
Nothing sells until a buyer buys - furniture is slow-moving and buyer-dependent; timing is not fully in your control.
The buyer must accept the item; delivery issues or disputes can delay payout.
Sale price varies with demand, brand, and condition; quotes can effectively change with the market.
Resale catch-all: value varies by condition and demand; quotes and market prices can change; fees or shipping can reduce your actual proceeds.

steps: List your furniture with photos (free listings)
Buyer purchases; AptDeco schedules managed pickup and delivery
Item is delivered to the buyer
You are paid out shortly after delivery, minus AptDeco's fee (about 19%-38%)
timing: Payout shortly after managed delivery; timing is buyer- and delivery-dependent.
who_pays: Your buyer - AptDeco is a furniture marketplace that manages pickup and delivery; your payout comes from the sale price after their fee.
who_qualifies: You must be 18+, in AptDeco's US service areas, and own the furniture. Item condition standards apply.
work_available: This is a marketplace for furniture, and furniture moves slowly - you wait on a buyer, a delivery slot, and the buyer's acceptance before any dollar moves.
what_gets_accepted: The buyer must accept the item on delivery; delivery issues or disputes can delay your payout. Good photos and honest condition notes reduce disputes.
costs_and_unpaid_time: AptDeco takes roughly 19%-38% of the sale price - pad your list price so your net hits your target. Listings are free and AptDeco handles pickup/delivery, but your unpaid time is photographing, listing, and waiting on the slow furniture market.
when_cash_arrives: Real cash - paid out shortly after the managed delivery is accepted, minus AptDeco's 19-38% fee. Timing is buyer- and delivery-dependent, not on a fixed schedule.
